items.title: Market Valuations Shifting: JM Financial's Post-Q1 India Strategy
items.description:
Valuations remain elevated even after a marginal cooldown — Nifty50 trades at 18.4x forward PE, with Pharma the priciest large-cap bet at 33.8x and IT re-rating sharply to 17.3x. On earnings, Nifty50 Q1FY27 EPS grew a strong 12.9% YoY, well ahead of the 4.5% estimate, led by broad-based strength across mid and small caps.

Venkatesh Balasubramaniam, MD & Head of Research at JM Financial Institutional Securities, joins us to decode the sector-wise valuation picture and share fresh stock calls — HAL and BEL valuations still look attractive, MTAR Technologies gets initiated with a large BUY, and Data Patterns is also a BUY. He explains why banks aren't a rush-to-buy yet, and why the focus should stay on domestic earnings visibility across infra, auto and consumer names.
